messages:
Sara (People Ops): Hey team — quick announcement! Arjun just welcomed a baby boy this morning and also got promoted to Senior ML Engineer 🎉👶
Arjun: omg thanks everyone ❤️ both news still sinking in. baby name is Kian. Promotion totally made my week.
Ellie: KIAN!!! congrats mama/papa? 🥹 when can we drop off cake?
Omar: double congratulations! sending noise-cancelling headphone recs for newborn naps :joy: 
Jane (CEO): Huge congrats Arjun — well deserved promotion and congrats on the little one. We'll get a celebration on calendar.
Mira: People Ops — can we coordinate a small cake and a baby gift? also +1 to cake next Wed? LMK budget.
Lina: I'm in for organizing. propose Wed 12:30 in HQ kitchen. works for folks?
Arjun: Wed works for me but may be on paternity hybrid that week; I'll try to swing by. thank you all 😭
GifBot: :confetti_ball: https://giphy.com/gifs/congrats-baby-3oz8xSkgno6btu8g6w
Sam: adding a tiny card from eng — who wants to add a message? pls drop a line here.
Mira: I'll put registry link in calendar invite once Arjun confirms shipping preference.
Ellie: request: no baby photos in company feed unless Arjun posts them first :heart:
Omar: noted. team coverage: who can pick up Arjun's oncall shift Fri? @Lina? :pray:
Lina: I can take Fri AM, Omar can do PM. tagging ops to confirm handoff.
Sara (People Ops): Thanks all — sending a short congratulations slack thread for the company channel after we confirm timing. :party_parrot: 
Arjun: I really appreciate everything. can't wait to celebrate with you all.
